title: Reverse the characters in each line of a text file or command output
summary: Use the `rev` command to flip the order of characters in every line of a file or the output of another command. This is often used for simple text transformations or debugging.

steps.explain: Run `rev` followed by the path to your file to print the reversed lines to the terminal.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the text file you want to reverse.

alternatives.explain: Pipe the output of any command into `rev` to reverse its output line by line.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to reverse.
